I am farming my small maize plot here in the North East. The land is not big, just over half a hectare, and I plant maize together with cowpea like my father did. I have no schooling and no money for big inputs, but I try to get some NPK from the agro-dealer when the subsidy comes, and I put the droppings from my goats on the field before the rains. I cannot irrigate — I wait for the rains in June, and my wife and children help me weed.
